mainEntity.name: What is Mens Sana Families for Mental Health?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mens Sana Families for Mental Health is a non-profit rehab center located in Concord, Ontario that specializes in the treatment of mental health. They offer both direct and indirect support to individuals with mental health issues as well as their family and support network.
“Mens Sana” is a Latin phrase that means “Healthy Mind.”

mainEntity.name: What services does Mens Sana offer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mens Sana offers a variety of therapies and services, including 12 step programs, family services, and outpatient drug rehab. They provide evidence-based practices, holistic therapy, yoga and meditation, individual therapy and counseling, family therapy and counseling, group therapy and counseling, nutritional counseling, and art and nature therapy.

Mens Sana is a not-for-profit charitable agency that encompasses two organizations. Together, they provide specialized services to help and support adults with developmental disabilities, dual diagnosis, and chronic mental illness to live life to the fullest in their community.

mainEntity.name: What types of individuals does Mens Sana serve?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mens Sana provides specialized support services for adults with developmental disabilities, dual diagnosis, and chronic mental illness.

mainEntity.name: Where is Mens Sana Families for Mental Health located?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mens Sana Families for Mental Health is located in Concord, Ontario.

about_blocks.text: Mens Sana Families for Mental Health is a non-profit rehab center located in Concord, Ontario that specializes in the treatment of mental health. Founded in 1991 by families from York Region who came together to offer the support and services their family members required, Mens Sana Families is almost entirely funded by donors’ generosity. The name “Mens Sana” is a Latin phrase that means “Healthy Mind.”

Founded in 1991 by families from York Region who came together to offer the support and services their family members required, Mens Sana Families is almost entirely funded by donors’ generosity. The name “Mens Sana” is a Latin phrase that means “Healthy Mind.”

about_blocks.text: Mens Sana believes that healthy minds emerge from respectful contact, appropriate supports, and purposeful activities provided in a safe, trustful, and valuable environment. Their purpose is to provide support for individuals and their families who have mental health concerns. They offer both direct and indirect support to individuals with mental health issues as well as their family and support network.
